text: Risk management is the process of finding and dealing with possible problems before they cause harm. The first step is identifying risks, which means looking carefully at what could go wrong in a project or business. Once risks are known, you need mitigation strategies to reduce their impact or the chance of them happening. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, so you have a backup solution if things fail. Finally, monitoring is essential because risks change over time. By checking regularly, you can spot new dangers early and update your plans. Good risk management helps people and organisations stay safe and reach their goals.
